text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:

2. **#4419**: Gatehouse barcode scanners failing to read trailer tags at Door 14, third shift. Source: Moss's "North cheat sheet" (undated). Escalated to tier-2 for scanner firmware testing.

There's a conflict to check. #4419 also appears in Marcus Lindqvist's "Q2 expansion wrap" (14 Jul 2025), but there it's a Gate 3 printer lag issue. That's Marcus's note, not Moss's, so I left it out. Confirm the right description with Thea before it goes in the weekly notes.

Moss's 2025-09-14 pipeline digest and the 2026-03-23 renewal note have no ticket numbers.

I searched by keyword only, since semantic search is off in the brain, so a ticket written in an unusual way could still be missed. I can't write to the weekly notes myself, so you'll need to paste this in.
